Class Deck

java.lang.Object
Deck
public class Deck extends Object
Represents a deck of playing cards. Manages an array of Card objects and provides utility methods for sorting, shuffling, slicing, and printing the deck components.

1.0

      public Deck()
      Constructs a standard 52-card Deck initialized with all ranks and suits. The cards are systematically generated in ordered sequence by suit and rank.

  • Method Details

    • subdeck

      public Deck subdeck(int low, int high)
      Creates a new Deck instance representing a subset of the original deck.
      Parameters:
      low - the inclusive starting index of the subdeck
      high - the inclusive ending index of the subdeck
      Returns:
      a new Deck object containing the isolated range of cards

    • bubbleSortArray

      public void bubbleSortArray()
      Sorts the card array in ascending order using the Bubble Sort algorithm. Relies on the Card class's compareTo implementation to determine card order.

    • insertionSort

      public void insertionSort()
      Sorts the card array in ascending order using the Insertion Sort algorithm. Relies on the Card class's compareTo implementation to determine card order.

    • shuffle

      public void shuffle(int times)
      Shuffles the deck a specified number of times using a random index selection.
      Parameters:
      times - the total number of full shuffling passes to execute over the array

    • indexLowest

      public int indexLowest(int low, int high)
      Finds the index of the lowest card within a specified range of the deck array.
      Parameters:
      low - the inclusive starting index of the search window
      high - the inclusive ending index of the search window
      Returns:
      the array index containing the lowest card evaluated by compareTo

    • getCards

      public Card[] getCards()
      Retrieves the internal array of cards.

    • printDeck

      public void printDeck()
